caption: Document-type classification and clause similarity over a corpus of 35 documents. Not a trained fraud/anomaly model.
variants_note: Four combinations were scored on these same documents (plain or filtered TF-IDF, with bank and NBFC policy separate or merged). The merge was chosen after seeing the confusion table, so treat the headline as the optimistic end.
